subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers adopt the linked fork PR’s post-dispatch cleanup shape, replace it with an owner-authored Google Chat lifecycle fix, or reject placeholder deletion for `NO_REPLY` turns?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and a closing PR is open, but choosing the final channel lifecycle shape affects Google Chat message delivery semantics and should not be duplicated by another automated fix.

options.title: Review or adopt linked PR
options.body: Use the open fork PR as the candidate fix if its cleanup timing, tests, and proof match the intended Google Chat lifecycle.

options.title: Replace with owner fix
options.body: Open a narrow same-repo replacement if the post-dispatch cleanup is right but the fork branch needs different lifecycle integration or validation.

options.title: Reject cleanup behavior
options.body: Close the candidate only if maintainers decide reaction-only `NO_REPLY` turns should not consume Google Chat's typing placeholder.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the open fork PR as the candidate fix if its cleanup timing, tests, and proof match the intended Google Chat lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current localized Google Chat monitor and reply-delivery helper on `main`, including the files that would need lifecycle integration.
